recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E：一個濾泡的生發中心內充滿淡嗜雙性、細胞質豐富的大型漿母細胞，與周圍深色小淋巴球形成明顯對比，旁邊有小血管；大細胞集中在生發中心內，符合 HHV8 陽性親生發中心淋巴增生性疾病。
features: Follicular germinal center largely occupied by aggregates of large plasmablastic cells
Large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli
Surrounding rim of small dark mantle zone lymphocytes
Scattered small vessels and a few apoptotic bodies
Architecture preserved outside the involved follicle
describe_en: Lymph node section at intermediate power shows a follicle whose germinal center is largely occupied by aggregates of large plasmablastic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli. These pale-staining aggregates contrast with the surrounding rim of small dark mantle zone lymphocytes, and a few small vessels and apoptotic bodies are present. The involvement is confined to the follicular compartment without diffuse effacement. Findings are consistent with HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder, pending confirmation with HHV8 LANA-1 and EBER.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers contain a polarized mix of centroblasts, centrocytes and tingible body macrophages that are CD20+/BCL6+, rather than cohesive clusters of CD20-negative plasmablasts.
FL grade 3 follicles are composed of CD20+/CD10+/BCL6+ centroblasts, usually BCL2+, and are HHV8/EBV negative.
MCD shows atrophic germinal centers with scattered single plasmablasts in the mantle zone rather than plasmablast aggregates filling the germinal center.
